summary:
Public Law 118-124, cited as the "Fiscal Year 2024 Veterans Affairs Major Medical Facility Authorization Act," authorizes the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to carry out 11 specified major medical facility projects during fiscal year 2024. 

Section 2(a) grants the Secretary authority to undertake these projects at designated locations, subject to specified cost ceilings for each. The authorized projects and their maximum amounts are: (1) American Lake, Washington (new specialty care building 201, renovation of building 18, parking expansion), not to exceed $155,600,000; (2) Dallas, Texas (mental health clinical space expansion, parking expansion, land acquisition), not to exceed $93,100,000; (3) El Paso, Texas (new health care center and utility plant), not to exceed $759,200,000; (4) Perry Point, Maryland (community living center replacement, parking expansion), not to exceed $274,310,000; (5) Portland, Oregon (seismic retrofit and renovation of buildings 100 and 101, roadway and site improvements, new specialty care facility, demolition and parking expansion), not to exceed $613,000,000; (6) Reno, Nevada (initiation of replacement of the Sierra Nevada Health Care System medical center, land acquisition, preliminary site work), not to exceed $223,800,000; (7) San Diego, California (new spinal cord injury building, partial renovation of building 1, parking, central utility plant upgrades, seismic retrofit of existing spinal cord injury building 11), not to exceed $311,700,000; (8) San Francisco, California (new research facility, parking structure, demolition), not to exceed $264,500,000; (9) San Juan, Puerto Rico (seismic corrections for building 1, new administrative building, outpatient clinic and parking structure expansion), not to exceed $370,370,000; (10) St. Louis, Missouri (Phase 1 bed tower replacement, clinical building expansion, administrative building and warehouse consolidation, water tower, new utility plant and parking garages), not to exceed $135,340,000; and (11) West Haven, Connecticut (new surgical and clinical space tower, renovation of buildings 1 and 2, demolition), not to exceed $153,128,000.

Section 2(b) authorizes the appropriation of $3,354,048,000 to the Secretary of Veterans Affairs for fiscal year 2024 or the year in which funds are appropriated for the Construction, Major Projects account, to fund the projects authorized under subsection (a). The Act provides an authorization of appropriations and does not itself appropriate funds. The Act was approved on November 25, 2024.
